description: Collection iteration, array patterns and snapshots; fixed arrays pass/return by value
notes: Current source build after v0.5.1. Repeat counts are positive integer literals; spread/rest produce Vec and range slicing produces Slice. C FFI array aggregates remain unsupported.

title: Array search
description: includes, indexOf and lastIndexOf for Array, Vec and Slice.
notes: Numeric, bool and str elements; missing indices return -1.

title: Array Methods / เมธอดของ array
description: Map, filter, reduce, callbacks, snapshots, join and queue methods.
notes: Current source after v0.5.1. Homogeneous Array, Vec and Slice; mutations require writable Vec. Callbacks take element and optional index: i64; reduce takes accumulator, element and optional index: i64.

title: Array Sort / เรียงลำดับสมาชิก
description: Stable numeric/string sorting and custom comparators, preserving snapshots.
notes: Current source after v0.5.1. sort mutates writable Vec and returns void; toSorted returns a new Vec from Array, Vec or Slice. Comparator fn(T,T):i64.

title: Array callback index / ตำแหน่งสมาชิก
description: Optional index: i64 for collection iteration callbacks and reduce.
notes: Current source after v0.5.1. Index is zero-based and relative to the receiver, including Slice. Previous callback signatures remain supported.

title: Array Reference: syntax / รูปแบบการเขียน
description: Fixed arrays, Vec, Slice, repeat, spread, destructuring and iteration.
notes: Current source build. Full typed collection reference is available on the Array Reference page.

title: Basic Array Methods / เมธอดพื้นฐาน
description: length, toString, isArray, delete, copyWithin, flat, splice and toSpliced.
notes: Current source after v0.5.1. Dense typed collections; mutators require writable Vec. flat depth is a literal 0..32. Native nested collections use Vec<Vec<T>>.
